They are massive corporations.We are just a little independent show.But that's what makes this incredible.Fox was built with the backingof Rupert Murdoch's News Corporation media empire.CNN was built by a super rich guyand is now owned by one of the largest media conglomerates on Earth.They have massive studios.They have corporateinfrastructure, international bureaus, gigantic promotional budgets.Effectively speaking, they have unlimited resources.We built this with no media conglomerate manufacturing and audience.We don't.A lot of people don't understand.When Fox and CNN decide to get on YouTube, they can put the full weightof their entire platform into driving people to their YouTube channel.And still without a billionaire underwriting years of lossesand all of that.We have defeated them on YouTube because individual people watchedand subscribed and shared clips and directlysupported the show, and look at what that has produced.So this to me is an inspirational story of without any of that,just me sitting here doing the content, my teamgetting it packaged and distributed, and folkslike you in the audience saying, I'm going to watch it, maybe I'll share it.We are not just on the same list as Fox and CNN.We are above Fox News.
